title: chore: remove retirementDate from the model registry
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed the `retirementDate` field and its 44 values from the model registry. Provider route deadlines remain as code comments beside their source notes, as the model-management skill now specifies. Removed the field’s fallback non-inheritance rule and test. The catalog export and model announcements no longer produce scheduled retirements, and the news index ignores retirement entries in older gists. A model is marked retired when the PR removing it merges. API and runtime behavior are unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden-shed archive, Polli wears a tiny librarian hat and files provider deadline notes beside code-plants while a friendly CRT robot clears outdated retirement notices from a terminal; lime green (#ecf874) glows against warm cream and soft pastel gradients, with warm lighting, an 8-bit aesthetic, and retro gaming vibes. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings.
